description:
We offer student accommodation in the heart of Galway City. We are less than a 15 minute walk from University of Galway (NUIG) or less than 15 minute bus ride to ATU. (Formally GMIT)

Triple and Quad rooms available.

Please note this accommodation is only 5 nights per week and not over the weekends. 

https://www.kinlaygalway.ie/student-accommodation-in-galway/

All bills and breakfast included.

Sunday - Friday: €165 per week. Typical example: 3 friends sharing: Check in Sunday evening, check out Fri morning.

"Awarded Best Hostel in Ireland 2025!'' 

If you would like a shared room rate but don't have room mates picked yet, we can match you up with roommates. 

Contact our dedicated student coordinator - students@kinlaygalway.ie or calling 087-4456261
